decisions.reason: Including supplied tables does not change the existing requirement to include supplied narrative content.
The source independently addresses tables and the organization chart; the organization-chart change is already fully represented by its own message 47 MODIFY.
Incorporating supplied tables does not necessarily alter the existing page-count target.
Photo incorporation is a separate requirement already established from message 47 and is not changed by the table-integration decision.
The requirement to incorporate supplied tables does not change the branding identity or brand-color source.
Table incorporation is an independent content-integration behavior and does not require changing the existing full-document layout or graphic-treatment attributes.
Including supplied tables does not change the requirement that the final PDF be print-ready.
